headline: Siddeshwari Tradex Private Limited Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for Jindal Saw Limited
sum: Siddeshwari Tradex Private Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under SEBI's Takeover Code for Jindal Saw Limited, signalling a substantial acquisition or takeover intent requiring regulatory transparency and public disclosure.
implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures are precursory filings that trigger the formal takeover framework; this signals that the acquirer has crossed or intends to cross the 5% threshold and must now comply with detailed disclosure, public announcement, and open offer obligations within statutory timeframes.
detail: Siddeshwari Tradex Private Limited has submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This filing is a mandatory preliminary step when an acquirer acquires or proposes to acquire shares of a listed company in excess of 5% of paid-up capital, or a person acting in concert with others aggregates such a threshold. The disclosure triggers obligations for public announcement of the open offer and detailed disclosures to shareholders. The specific consideration, number of shares acquired, and timeline for the public offer have not been disclosed in the available public sources as of the filing date.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 26
framework.note: Public announcement requirements; acquirer must announce intention to acquire and offer terms within 4 days of acquisition or intent.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 - Regulation 36
framework.note: Manner and timing of open offer; 21-day offer period post-public announcement; legal framework for consideration and offer price.
Provides legislative basis for SEBI's takeover code and regulatory framework for listed companies.
If the acquisition involves a scheme, NCLT approval under Section 230-232 may be required; not indicated in this disclosure.

framework.ref: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (FEMA) - if applicable
framework.note: If Siddeshwari Tradex or its ultimate beneficial owner is a non-resident, FDI restrictions and RBI approval (if >25%) may apply.

conditions: Acquisition crossing or intending to cross 5% paid-up capital threshold of Jindal Saw Limited
Compliance with SEBI Takeover Code's public announcement requirement within 4 days of acquisition intent
Open offer to all shareholders at a price determined by valuation principles under Regulation 36
approvals: Public announcement by acquirer (within statutory window)
Open offer filing with SEBI and stock exchange approval
Potential RBI approval if acquirer has FDI implications (>25% stake)

Provides regulatory framework authority to SEBI to impose takeover disclosure and open offer rules.
